article.headline: Central Arkansas opens with an 85-55 win over Oral Roberts behind Ty Robinson’s 29
article.description: — Ty Robinson’s 29 points helped Central Arkansas make a winning start Monday with an 85-55 victory over Oral Roberts.
article.linkText: Central Arkansas opens with an 85-55 win over Oral Roberts behind Ty Robinson’s 29

categories.description: Oral Roberts Golden Eagles @ Central Arkansas Bears

event.description: Oral Roberts Golden Eagles @ Central Arkansas Bears

keywords: Oral Roberts Golden Eagles @ Central Arkansas Bears
article.story: CONWAY, Ark. -- — Ty Robinson’s 29 points helped Central Arkansas make a winning start Monday with an 85-55 victory over Oral Roberts. Robinson also contributed four steals for the Bears. Harry Beauchamp scored 15 points while going 6 for 15 from the field, including 3 for 10 from 3-point range. Rylie Marshall had 11 points and shot 4 for 6 from the field, including 3 for 5 from beyond the arc. Luke Gray finished with 22 points for the Golden Eagles. Cal Furnish added 11 points for Oral Roberts. Boden Williams also had eight points and three steals. Up next Central Arkansas plays at Ole Miss on Friday, and Oral Roberts hosts Northwestern Oklahoma State on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
